jobs.title: Strategic Finance Lead
jobs.description:
Overview

Inferact's mission is to grow vLLM as the world's AI inference engine and accelerate AI progress by making inference cheaper and faster. Founded by the creators and core maintainers of vLLM, we sit at the intersection of models and hardware, a position that took years to build.



About the Role

We're looking for a Strategic Finance Lead to help shape how Inferact grows, invests, and scales. You'll turn questions about inference economics, pricing, commercial opportunities, compute spending, and hiring into rigorous financial models and clear recommendations. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move from an ambiguous business question to the underlying data, build the analysis themselves, and help leadership make a better decision.

You'll partner closely with founders, engineering, infrastructure, go-to-market, People, and the Corporate Controller to evaluate growth and investment priorities, understand customer and product profitability, and make resource tradeoffs explicit. Alongside this strategic work, you'll own the operating model, budgeting, rolling forecasts, headcount and expense planning, and cash runway scenarios. You'll also support board discussions and fundraising with clear financial narratives and decision materials. The Controller will own accounting and reliable actuals; you'll translate those inputs into a forward-looking view of the business and practical recommendations.



Skills and Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

 - Experience personally owning strategic finance, business planning, or financial analysis for a growing technology business, with evidence that your work influenced operating or investment decisions.

 - Strong financial modeling skills, including driver-based revenue and expense forecasts, headcount plans, and the ability to connect the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow.

 - Commercial and operating judgment: you can evaluate unit economics, investment returns, pricing, and resource allocation while making assumptions and uncertainty explicit.

 - Ability to reconcile plans with accounting actuals, explain performance variances, and distinguish changes in business performance from timing, data, or modeling issues.

 - Advanced spreadsheet and analytical skills, with the ability to combine financial and operational data into models that others can inspect, maintain, and use.

 - Strong communication and business-partnering skills, including the ability to challenge assumptions constructively and explain financial tradeoffs to technical and non-financial leaders.

 - Comfort owning ambiguous finance projects end-to-end, balancing strategic analysis with recurring planning and forecasting, and prioritizing useful decisions over unnecessary process.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience with AI infrastructure, cloud platforms, developer tools, usage-based software, or businesses where infrastructure cost and customer consumption materially affect margins.

 - Experience partnering with engineering and infrastructure teams on compute costs, capacity commitments, utilization, and the financial implications of different deployment models.

 - Experience preparing board reporting, fundraising models, investor analyses, or decision materials for senior leadership.

 - Experience planning for a distributed or international organization, including headcount, hiring timing, and geographic cost differences.

 - Experience improving planning systems, dashboards, data integrations, or automated reporting; SQL or lightweight scripting is helpful but not required.

Bonus points if you have:

 - Built strategic finance models, decision processes, or a planning foundation before a company had an established finance operating cadence.

 - Connected product usage, infrastructure costs, and commercial terms to customer or product profitability and influenced a concrete business decision.

 - Improved forecast quality and management visibility without slowing execution or requiring a large finance team.

 - Built trusted, self-service financial reporting or used automation to reduce repetitive analysis while preserving review and data quality.



Logistics

 - Location: This role is based in San Francisco, California and is on-site.

 - Compensation: The compensation package, including base salary and equity terms, is to be determined based on the final role scope, background, skills, and experience.

 - Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas on a case-by-case basis.

 - Benefits: Inferact offers generous health, dental, and vision benefits as well as 401(k) company match.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Inferact's mission is to grow vLLM as the world's AI inference engine and accelerate AI progress by making inference cheaper and faster. Founded by the creators and core maintainers of vLLM, we sit at the intersection of models and hardware, a position that took years to build.



About the Role

We're looking for a Field Marketing Manager to own the global event engine for vLLM and Inferact, from major conferences and flagship vLLM events to local developer meetups and partner activations.

This is an end-to-end execution role. You will own event strategy, venues, sponsorships, budgets, speakers, registration, CRM capture, vendors, onsite operations, and post-event follow-up. You will also build the repeatable playbooks and ecosystem partnerships that let Inferact scale events across the US, Europe, and APAC.



 

30-60-90 Day Milestones

30 Days: Outside Counsel Alignment & Contracting Intake

 - Plan the next Inferact conference attendance end-to-end, including format, date, venue, speaker lineup, sponsors, and budget.

 - Plan and run one vLLM meetup with a host partner and turn it into the first repeatable meetup playbook.

 - Build the conference sign-up system, including registration pages, RSVP and waitlist handling, confirmation and reminder emails, check-in, and CRM data flow.

 - Take over coordination of the already-booked Q4 calendar, starting with PyTorch NA

60 Days: Frontier AI & Regulatory Strategy

 - Own vLLM Conference US as the flagship event, including venue, sponsorship packages, program committee, speakers, and registration.

 - Own vLLM Conference China, including co-hosting terms with the PyTorch Foundation, branding, local vendors, and speaker coordination.

 - Own the global vLLM meetup program and Inferact company-hosted events across the US, Europe, and APAC.

 - Own event budgets, sponsorship decisions, lead capture, and post-event follow-up for every event.

90 Days: Scalable Legal Infrastructure

 - Build a forward-looking partnership plan for hardware vendors, cloud providers, model labs, and open-source foundations we co-host with or sponsor.

 - Design a repeatable ecosystem events program for partners such as Google, AMD, and NVIDIA to participate in vLLM events.

 - Work with external event support to attract sponsors and participants around vLLM Conference launches, while developing clear positioning and marketing guidelines for Inferact vs. vLLM across conferences and events.



Skills and Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

 - Proven ownership of 500+ attendee conferences, enterprise events, or developer meetups from planning through onsite execution and post-event follow-up.

 - Hands-on experience owning venue selection, sponsorships, budgets, vendors, speaker coordination, registration, attendee communications, and onsite logistics.

 - Hands-on experience setting up event registration, landing pages, and automated CRM lead capture using tools such as HubSpot, Marketo, Luma, or comparable systems.

 - Experience measuring event performance through attendance, engagement, lead capture, pipeline influence, or partner outcomes.

 - Ability to manage multiple concurrent events and workstreams with high attention to detail and urgency.

 - Strong cross-functional skills with sales, partnerships, engineering, executives, design, agencies, and external vendors.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience running developer, AI, cloud, infrastructure, or open-source events.

 - Experience managing global event portfolios across the US, Europe, and APAC.

 - Experience designing sponsorship packages and managing partner participation in flagship conferences.

 - Track record creating event playbooks, scalable operating systems, and consistent post-event follow-up processes.

Bonus points if you have:

 - Experience with PyTorch, AI infrastructure, developer tools, cloud, GPU, or open-source communities.

 - Existing relationships across cloud providers, hardware vendors, model labs, or open-source foundations.

 - Experience building a field marketing function or global meetup program from 0 to 1.



Logistics

 - Location: San Francisco, CA (On-site)

 - Compensation: Compensation determined based on background, skills, and experience. Offers include competitive base salary & meaningful equity.

 - Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas on a case-by-case basis.

 - Benefits: Inferact offers generous health, dental, and vision benefits as well as 401(k) company match.

jobs.title: Enterprise Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Inferact's mission is to grow vLLM as the world's AI inference engine and accelerate AI progress by making inference cheaper and faster. Founded by the creators and core maintainers of vLLM, we sit at the intersection of models and hardware, a position that took years to build.

About the Role

We're looking for an Enterprise Partnerships Manager to own and grow Inferact's strategic relationships across the hardware and infrastructure ecosystem. Inferact works closely with major GPU and semiconductor partners, including organizations such as NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel, through commercial relationships that are strategically important to the company and require dedicated ownership beyond the technical work itself.

You'll serve as the commercial owner for a focused set of complex enterprise partnerships, coordinating across partner stakeholders and Inferact's engineering, product, legal, finance, and leadership teams. This role requires someone who understands open-source software, can navigate GPU and infrastructure ecosystems, and can operate comfortably between large enterprises and a fast-moving startup. The goal is to keep strategic partnerships moving, make the relationships easier to operate, and ensure they create leverage rather than drag for the core business. Existing partnerships are the immediate priority. Over time, you'll proactively reach out to new potential partners, including emerging accelerator companies, to build relationships and gather market intelligence even when no immediate formal partnership is planned.

Skills and Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

 - Experience owning strategic partnerships, business development, enterprise accounts, or ecosystem relationships with large technology companies.

 - Strong commercial judgment with experience managing complex agreements, partner economics, multi-stakeholder negotiations, and ongoing relationship execution.

 - Experience working with GPU providers, hardware companies, cloud infrastructure partners, AI infrastructure vendors, or closely adjacent technical ecosystems.

 - Understanding of open-source software and the commercial dynamics that emerge when open-source technology sits at the center of a broader hardware and infrastructure ecosystem.

 - Ability to navigate complex enterprise organizations, identify the real decision-makers and dependencies, and maintain momentum across technical, legal, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders.

 - Ability to operate with high autonomy in a startup where partnership structures, internal processes, and strategic priorities are still evolving. You should be comfortable researching prospects and initiating outreach yourself, without relying on an SDR.

 - Strong written and verbal communication with the ability to synthesize complex partner context into clear decisions, recommendations, and action plans.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Direct experience managing relationships with companies such as NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, hyperscalers, GPU clouds, semiconductor companies, or infrastructure providers.

 - Experience in AI infrastructure, model serving, developer infrastructure, open-source platforms, cloud computing, semiconductors, or enterprise technical partnerships.

 - Prior startup or high-growth company experience, especially where enterprise partners were materially larger and more complex than the company itself.

 - Experience coordinating commercial partnerships that also involve meaningful technical delivery, engineering dependencies, or joint product work.

 - Strong executive communication skills and the ability to represent a highly technical company credibly with senior external stakeholders.

Bonus points if you have:

 - Managed a major hardware or cloud partner from initial commercial agreement through delivery, expansion, and executive relationship management.

 - Worked in an open-source company where partners, customers, contributors, and potential competitors frequently overlapped.

 - Built operating cadences, account plans, and internal coordination mechanisms for a small set of strategically critical enterprise relationships.

 - Negotiated or managed high-value commercial agreements with technically complex deliverables and multiple internal stakeholders.

 - Successfully moved from a larger technology company into an early-stage startup and demonstrated comfort with ambiguity, speed, and broad ownership.

Logistics

 - Location: This role is based in San Francisco, California and is on-site.

 - Compensation: Compensation will be determined based on background, skills, and experience. Offers include equity.

 - Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas on a case-by-case basis.

 - Benefits: Inferact offers generous health, dental, and vision benefits as well as 401(k) company match.
